card.name: Engine power numbers before horsepower
card.fires_on: The number or hyphen just before "horsepower" or "hp" in engine and pump ratings. It also fires on words right before "horse" in text about horses.

modes.label: Power rating
modes.description: A number or hyphen right before horsepower or hp in a machine rating.

modes.label: Before horse
modes.description: A word just before the word horse in text about the animal.
modes.example: he rode not on the back of a<< war>>horse, but a donkey.

card.writes: It pushes the model to output horse, horses and the Chinese character for horse.
card.plain: It spots places where the next word is likely to be horse or horsepower, mostly in engine ratings.
